item.title: Nvidia Paper Finds Irrelevant Text Weakens Models via Intrusion Heads
item.description:
A new Nvidia-led paper finds that irrelevant text in RAG, tool-use and long-context prompts hurts models mainly by weakening their use of the question rather than directly suppressing the right answer. The authors identify a small set of 'intrusion heads' inside open models that read unrelated text and dilute the answer; masking about 10 such heads on 7B-scale models recovered 57% of the accuracy lost to distractors on average, versus a 97.6% oracle ceiling.

原文标题：英伟达论文揭示无关文本通过干扰注意力头削弱模型

Why it matters：给出了无关上下文损害模型的可解释机制与免训练修复手段，对 RAG 与长上下文工程有直接指导价值。

item.title: Ex-Toutiao CEO Chen Lin Confirms Departure to Launch AI Education Startup
item.description:
Chen Lin, former CEO of Toutiao and Dali Education, publicly confirmed for the first time that he has left ByteDance and is preparing an AI education startup called Xiaolu Aixue (Galaxy Zhixue). He said the AI shift sparked by ChatGPT, which is gradually replacing professional skills with machines, drove him to rethink how the next generation can achieve lasting growth.

item.title: Seele03 Generates Editable Unity and Godot Game Projects
item.description:
Seele AI has released Seele03, a model that works with built-in asset generators to output editable Unity, Godot or web game projects rather than a one-shot game. Its value lies in unifying mesh generation, rigging, sound and code in one place, enabling a build-play-fix iteration loop and cutting integration overhead for small teams.

Why it matters：它把生成式模型接入真实游戏引擎工程流，代表 AI 辅助开发从单次生成转向可迭代的资产与代码管线。

item.title: IBM to Embed Anthropic's Claude Mythos in Concert Protect Scanner
item.description:
IBM plans to embed Anthropic's Claude Mythos into IBM Concert Protect so enterprises can hunt unknown logic flaws and potential zero-days that lack signatures or CVE records. Findings are routed to a Proof of Exploitability step that checks code, configuration and infrastructure for real attacker reachability; in one IBM case this reduced over 5,700 scanner findings to 12 proven exploitable vulnerabilities. Mythos had previously been used only for internal security research via Anthropic's gated Project Glasswing program.

原文标题：IBM 将 Claude Mythos 引入代码漏洞扫描

Why it matters：大模型进入企业代码安全扫描主流程，且给出告警收敛的真实量化案例，对安全与 AI 工程读者有直接参考价值。

item.description:

item.title: Zhengyuan Quantum Raises Angel Round to Build Thousand-Qubit Superconducting Quantum Computer
item.description:

Founded in February 2026, the startup focuses on chip connectivity and control, pursuing TSV 3D packaging, cryogenic interconnects, and integrated measurement and control, and has already received orders for parametric amplifiers and other components.

item.description:

The company is advancing its 200mm SiC roadmap and has validated cold-split technology on 12-inch SiC at its Dresden site to cut ingot-to-wafer losses.

The two will train custom generative models on Disney characters, environments and visual styles under artist-led development, and Disney Imagineering has already begun using Firefly Foundry to turn hand-drawn sketches into 2D concept art.

item.title: Claude Fable 5.2 Tops VIALS-AA Scientific Visual Reasoning Benchmark
item.description:
Artificial Analysis built VIALS-AA on Handshake AI's VIALS benchmark to test visual reasoning over life-science artifacts such as gel blots, plasmid maps and phylogenies. Claude Fable 5.2 leads at 67%, ahead of Gemini 4 Carbon (64%) and GPT-6 Astra (63%). The more notable signal is tool-use strategy: Fable averages roughly 37 tool calls per task with heavy batching, versus about 8 for Astra, suggesting reasoning models are shifting toward multi-step tool orchestration rather than single-shot answers.

原文标题：Claude Fable 5.2 登顶生命科学视觉推理榜

Why it matters：第三方独立评测揭示前沿模型在专业科学视觉推理上的差距，并首次量化工具调用策略差异，对模型选型有直接参考价值。

Total goods trade rose 20% in the first ten months, with both exports and imports posting six consecutive months of double-digit growth, signaling strong external demand for semiconductors.

item.title: Ant Group's Lingbo Open-Sources LingBot-Touch Tactile Foundation Model
item.description:
Ant Group's Lingbo Technology has open-sourced LingBot-Touch, a tactile foundation model pretrained on nearly 5,000 hours of real-world tactile data. It unifies signals from magnetic, vision-based and piezoresistive sensors into a single tactile representation reusable across sensors, dexterous hands, models and tasks. Across 26 real-robot tests, plugging in the representation lifted average task success for four action models by roughly 14 to 26 percentage points, with bottle-cap twisting rising from 56.25% to 90%.

原文标题：蚂蚁灵波开源触觉基础模型 LingBot-Touch

Why it matters：为具身智能补齐触觉感知这一关键模态，且以开源模型与真机量化结果给出可复用方案。

item.title: Boston Dynamics Fits Atlas Humanoid with Wheels for High-Speed Mobility
item.description:
Boston Dynamics released a video showing a modified Atlas humanoid with electric scooter wheels bolted to its ankle actuators via custom adapters, requiring no major hardware or software rebuild beyond swapping feet for wheels in simulation. The wheeled Atlas can jump and spin, sprint laterally, and completed a jump-and-spin on its first try using a trajectory-tracking controller, serving as a testbed for sustained actuator load and heavy-payload performance. It is a research platform, not a commercial product.

item.title: Nvidia Lobbied Against Rules on Remote Chip Access
item.description:
Two current US Commerce officials told The Information that Nvidia lobbied especially hard against any rules on remote access, the route Chinese AI labs use to reach restricted chips in Singapore and Malaysia data centers. That lobbying, plus opposition from officials, previously stopped Commerce and Congress from writing new rules. In late October, the White House asked Congress to add a provision to the Overwatch Act requiring Commerce to write a rule against remote access to certain chips, and to narrow the Match Act so it covers only advanced chip production, sparing legacy lines.

原文标题：英伟达游说反对限制远程访问芯片

Why it matters：这条消息披露了美国芯片出口管制中远程访问这一关键漏洞，以及英伟达的游说如何影响政策走向，对关注算力地缘格局的读者有实质信息价值。

item.title: OpenAI Deploys Control Room System to Halt Rogue Agents in 35 Seconds
item.description:
OpenAI has deployed an internal Control Room system that routes agent training, evaluation and data-processing workloads through a central authorization service, capable of blocking further model output within 35 seconds of a stop order. Unlike passive monitoring, it actively intercepts risky tasks via per-task IDs validated against the inference engine, with dedicated model monitors attached to all frontier reinforcement learning runs.
